content:
Inauguration of the National Outreach Program for Faculty at UET Mardan
Day 1 of the
National Outreach Program for Faculty
at
UET Mardan
marked an impactful beginning to what promises to be a transformative journey in academic development and professional excellence.
This 20-day training program, running from
April 24 to May 20, 2025
, brings together
30 faculty participants from various departments
of UET Mardan. Over the course of the program, participants will engage with
9 comprehensive modules
designed to enhance teaching effectiveness, research skills, and academic leadership.
The opening ceremony was held in the morning, graced by the presence of
Dr. Ibrar Ali Shah
, Chairman of the Department of Computer Software Engineering, UET Mardan, as the
Chief Guest
. The event also welcomed representatives from
NAHE-HEC
and university leadership, who together unveiled the structure, objectives, and vision behind this prestigious faculty development initiative. The ceremony formally welcomed the selected faculty members.
After the Inauguration, participants dove straight into the first module titled
"Teaching as a Profession
in Higher Education
"
, delivered by
Dr. Tajjudin Sharar
, Assistant Professor and Provost at the University of Chitral. Dr. Sharar led an engaging session that explored the philosophical and ethical foundations of teaching, the challenges educators face in maintaining professional excellence, and strategies for balancing teaching, research, and administrative roles. Real-life case studies enriched the discussion, sparking deep reflection among participants.
With a strong blend of ceremonial inspiration and academic depth, Day 1 has set the tone for a dynamic and engaging faculty development journey. The energy, collaboration, and sense of purpose among participants were truly inspiring.

content:
Awareness Seminar on Anti-Drug measures in Collaboration with the Anti-Narcotics Force (ANF), the Higher Education Regulatory Authority (HERA), and the Anti-Counter Violence and Extremism Department
On 20th Feb, 2025 UET Mardan organized an awareness seminar on anti-drug measures in collaboration with the Anti-Narcotics Force (ANF), the Higher Education Regulatory Authority (HERA), and the Anti-Counter Violence and Extremism Department. The Vice Chancellor of UET Mardan welcomed the guests, emphasizing the university’s commitment to raising awareness about drug abuse among students. Inspector Fukraz from ANF provided insightful guidance on different forms of drugs, educating students about their harmful effects. Additionally, representatives from HERA and the Anti-Counter Violence and Extremism Department highlighted the dangers of drug abuse and its impact on society. The seminar concluded with ANF presenting a shield to Dr. Sajjad Ali, Director Academics, in appreciation of his support and contributions to the cause.

content:
Seminar on Research Paper Writing from FYP Thesis Held at UET Mardan
A one-day seminar titled "How to Write a Research Paper from an FYP Thesis" was conducted by Dr. Shayan Tariq Jan, Lecturer in the Department of Electrical Engineering, UET Mardan, on November 28, 2024. The seminar was highly valued by final-year students, postgraduate students, and faculty members of the university.
Participants included students from various departments such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Civil Engineering, and Telecommunication, alongside faculty members, including Dr. Ajmal Farooq (Assistant Professor, EED), Dr. Irfan Khan (Lecturer, EED), Dr. Jawad Ali (Lecturer, EED), and Engr. Muhammad Israr (Lecturer, EED), who actively attended the session.
Dr. Shayan Tariq Jan introduced attendees to essential topics such as conducting surveys, performing literature reviews, understanding research methodology, analyzing results and discussions, referencing, and structuring appendices as the fundamental components of a research article. Furthermore, he discussed effective methods and guidelines to make research work presentable, plagiarism-free, and comprehensible.
At the conclusion of the seminar, a certificate of appreciation was presented to Dr. Shayan Tariq Jan by Engr. Muhammad Israr as a token of gratitude for his valuable time and dedication.
Seminars like this are essential in today's academic and professional landscape, as engineering theses often lead to significant advancements and innovations that need to be shared for further enhancement and reproducibility. Dr. Jawad Ali concluded the event by thanking the audience and the speaker for their participation and contribution.

title: Seminar on Professional Development & Career Counselling
description:
Seminar on Professional Development & Career Counselling
The Directorate of Office of Research, Innovation, and Commercialization arranged seminar on Professional Development and Career Counseling emphasized key strategies for fostering growth and success in today's competitive landscape. Special fo
content:
Seminar on Professional Development & Career Counselling
The Directorate of Office of Research, Innovation, and Commercialization arranged seminar on Professional Development and Career Counseling emphasized key strategies for fostering growth and success in today's competitive landscape. Special focus was placed on empowering women to excel in global markets by securing projects and achieving financial independence. The importance of skill enhancement to meet international standards was also emphasized, with resources like HEC’s Coursera programs, Udemy, and YouTube identified as valuable tools for continuous learning.
Participants were guided on building strong professional profiles and improving communication skills to gain a competitive edge. The discussion explored diverse career opportunities, ranging from technical fields such as computer science and software engineering to creative non-technical domains like graphic designing, video editing, and content writing. Freelancing platforms like Fiverr, Upwork, and Freelancer were presented as viable options for earning, alongside the potential for remote work with international companies.
The session also covered entrepreneurial avenues, emphasizing the importance of selling skills and services online, becoming a virtual assistant (VA), and leveraging e-commerce platforms like Amazon. Practical tips for excelling in interviews and succeeding in workplace environments were shared to help participants thrive in professional settings. Additionally, the importance of managerial skills, project management, and software quality assurance (SQA) was discussed as essential tools for building a successful business and ensuring sustainable growth. Overall, the session provided a holistic roadmap for navigating career opportunities and achieving personal and professional success.

content:
UET Mardan Holds Solidarity Event for kashmir
Under the direction of the Vice Chancellor of UET Mardan, the Director of Clubs and Societies organized an event titled 'Youm-e-Istehsaal Kashmir' to express solidarity with the people of Kashmir and protest against the Indian government's actions. The event featured a walk with participation from the university's Registrar, Prof. Dr. Ibrar Ali Shah, Chairman of the Computer Science Department, Dr. Muhammad Usman, Director of Clubs and Societies, faculty members, and students. During the event, a minute of silence was observed, and prayers were offered for the victims and their families. The event highlighted the ongoing Kashmir issue and condemned the reported atrocities committed by Indian forces in the region, emphasizing the importance of international attention and intervention. On August 5, 2019, the Government of India revoked Article 370, which granted special autonomy to Jammu and Kashmir, marking a significant shift in the region's political status.

content:
UET Mardan Student Wining 3rd position at Pakistan Engineering Council Capstone Expo-2024
We are thrilled to announce that Final Year Project from Department of Electrical Engineering, UET Mardan titled, "Remote Control Solar Powered Water Surface Garbage Collecting Boat", has secured the 3rd Position at the Pakistan Engineering Council 7th Engineering Capstone EXPO-2024!
This innovative project, supervised by Dr. Gul Rukh and executed by students - Hamza Iqbal, Asad Ullah, Muhammad Qasim Khan, and Khalid Shah - showcases our university's commitment to fostering creativity, innovation, and sustainability. Our students' hard work and dedication have paid off.
This achievement is a testament to our university's strong focus on providing a world-class education and preparing our students to tackle real-world challenges.
We congratulate our students and supervisor on this outstanding achievement!
